{{Top|leg}}
'''Micro-power cells''' were a type of power cell.

==Characteristics==
Micro-power cells were smaller than typical power cells, typically held less power, and were used when size was a factor. Micro-power cells were used in microscopic [[Nanovirus|nanokiller]] tech; as long as the nanokiller particles were exposed to enough ambient light, they could recharge their micro-power cells every few days.

==History==
The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] used micro-power cells to enable more control over [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber's]] charge levels.
